name.value: Rocky Mountain Springs Lodge and Restaurant

description.value: Rocky Mountain Springs Lodge is a hilltop motel in Radium Hot Springs, BC, marketed for its panoramic Rocky Mountain panorama—the 'Million Dollar View' that names its website—with a licensed patio and private balconies on upper-floor rooms. The property operates Peak Horn Hotpot & Bubble Tea as its on-site restaurant, offering guests an evening dining option without leaving the premises. It sits close to Kootenay National Park and the Columbia Valley cycling corridor, making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists travelling the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at milliondollarview.ca is live and confirms an active motel in Radium Hot Springs with rooms content updated April 2022 and a copyright of 2026. The rooms page explicitly states 'wireless internet throughout the property,' confirming Wi-Fi; an on-site restaurant (Peak Horn Hotpot & Bubble Tea) is confirmed as operating. No bike storage, laundry, e-bike charging, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere in the website content. The website contact page lists mobile numbers 250-341-4149 / 403-957-2288, which differ from the OSM toll-free number +1-877-457-1117, and the operating name on the website differs from the OSM name.
concerns: Phone mismatch: OSM lists toll-free +1-877-457-1117; website contact page lists mobile numbers 250-341-4149 and 403-957-2288 with no mention of the toll-free number.

Name mismatch: OSM name is 'Rocky Mountain Springs Lodge and Restaurant'; current website branding is 'Rocky Mountain Springs Lodge & Peak Horn Hotpot & Bubble Tea' — the restaurant component appears to have been rebranded.
Website blog content is largely from 2017–2019 with only one 2022 post, suggesting the site is not actively maintained, though the copyright footer reads 2026.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The motel is a plausible touring cyclist stopover on the Columbia Valley route, but neither required criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) can be confirmed from available evidence; a direct inquiry is needed before a confident include decision.
